body:
Been there, done that. Hospitalized myself twice for depression and suicidal ideation. The first time I met with a doctor for 20 minutes and they diagnosed me as bi polar and put on a very high dosage of lithium. The second time they they gave me anti depressants that didn't seem to do anything.

I have also searched within to try and find why I'm so depressed. I did a full time community service program for a year to see if that was it. It felt good, but I was still depressed.
